question: Can a calibration of the R13 WDL probabilities improve first and ordered-three 90-minute scores in the Europa League league phase by changing the relative weights of home-win, draw and away-win score cells?
population: Use exactly the three 72-fixture R30 Europa League windows, original R5 panel, frozen R7 fit and verified R13 score matrices, dedicated WDL probabilities and actual-line decisions. Fit on 2025/26 league phase before 2025-11-07, choose on its remaining rounds, and evaluate the 2026/27 archive through 2026-11-05. The holdout is time-separated for this recipe and has already been used in project research. Read the original actual outcomes only as fitting or review labels.
model: Fit a bounded regularized multiclass calibration on the logged probabilities of the independent R13 WDL head. The home, draw, away logits are (1+t)*log(p)+[h,d,0]. Minimize WDL negative log likelihood plus 6*(t^2+h^2+d^2), with t in [-0.6,0.6] and both intercepts in [-0.65,0.65]. Round the three fitted coefficients to six decimals. At each dose 0,0.5,1 blend the calibrated and original WDL probabilities. For score selection multiply each original R13 cell by the new-to-old WDL probability ratio for its outcome and normalize the whole grid. Relative score probabilities conditional on each outcome remain the same. At dose zero use the signed R13 selections. For positive doses use maximum adjusted probability for the first score, the next two cells for alternates, and the independently adjusted WDL head for direction. Keep the actual-line R13 total choice and original market comparison in every arm.
selection: Admit doses which at least tie the original on first, ordered-three and WDL hits in validation. Choose by first hits, then three hits, then WDL hits, then lower WDL log loss and smaller dose. Report all fixed doses and the selected policy on the same evaluation fixtures. Include actual per-competition hits, paired gains, losses and match-date intervals, original market coverage and the maximum probability error within a score outcome. Document whether distant exact scores share the realized WDL with the three displayed scores.
forward: A positive selected dose with holdout net gain in at least one score metric, no loss in the other, and no net WDL loss qualifies for a new independent pregame research comparison using the same locked input recipe and complete registered future population. Preserve already published firsts and original stage evaluation. If the screen fails, retain this as a development result without an additional R31 slate. Stage credit uses only confirmed actual future first displays, original strict real-line and market conditions, and regulation results.
